title: Spider
description: A spider walks over hills toward the ground under the pointer. FABRIK chains solve its legs, and springs move its body, both using pmndrs/math on the CPU. The GPU generates fractal Perlin terrain with @typegpu/noise and bakes it into a mesh. A single readback lets the feet land on the drawn triangles.
line: A spider walking over GPU-made hills, its legs solved with pmndrs/math.
hint: point at the ground · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
